verdict.rationale: Official iOS App Store listing details rich mobile-native features (voice mode, photo upload, image generation, stickers) and docs explicitly reference continuing tasks in 'ChatGPT Work on the web, iOS, or Android,' confirming a full official Android app as well. Missing for 10: dedicated Android app store evidence/listing, explicit feature-parity confirmation between iOS and Android, and independent hands-on reviews of the mobile apps' quality.
